coder_notes: Convection-enhanced delivery coded as formulation_flag new_route; device_dependent left false because CED catheter infusion is the route of administration rather than a device activating or enabling delivery across a barrier. Tumour PK coded no: distribution is by MRI of co-infused contrast, not a drug concentration measurement; a reviewer may judge otherwise. Target engagement from tumour tissue binding/mechanism confirmation.
